title: Projection-defined modules reveal mouse motor cortex architecture.

verified.what_i_actually_checked: Ran paper_context.py: paywalled, not in PMC, no supplement, no GEO/SRA/BioProject links, no Zenodo/Dryad hits; only RRIDs (software, mouse strains, an Addgene plasmid) were text-mined. Two web searches found only the Cell page and press coverage, no data download page.
verified.what_came_from_paper_text_only: From the abstract and press articles: 16 modules defined by clustering subcortical projections from 547 Allen Mouse Brain Connectivity Atlas tracing experiments; the module map is said to be released through BrainGlobe (an open atlas toolkit). I did not find or open that file.

a1_downloadable.note: No deposited dataset found for this paper (paper-only check plus searches). The raw inputs are the public Allen Connectivity Atlas, but the paper's module assignments were not located; the BrainGlobe release is mentioned only in press coverage.

a2_label_is_a_column.note: The only candidate label, module membership, was not found as a downloadable column. Otherwise it would have to be rebuilt by re-running the authors' clustering (not checked in files).

a3_inputs_present.note: Projection-density inputs exist publicly in the Allen Mouse Brain Connectivity Atlas (known resource, not opened here).

a4_units_stated.note: Allen projection density/energy is a documented normalized fluorescence measure (known resource, not checked in files).

a5_enough_rows.note: 547 tracing experiments per press reports (not verified), under the ~1,500 regression bar; it would pass the 400 classification bar only if the labels were independent, which they aren't (A8).

a6_fits_laptop.note: Region-by-experiment projection tables are small; voxel-level volumes would be larger but can be subset.

a7_counts_match_paper.note: No file to count; only the 547 figure from press coverage.

a8_label_provenance.note: The modules are clusters computed from the projection patterns themselves, so predicting module from projections is circular: the label is derived from the features.

backbone.name: none applicable (tracer projection maps have no standard open pretrained backbone)
backbone.licence: Allen Institute terms of use for the source atlas

integration.partner_dataset: Allen Mouse Brain Connectivity Atlas; BICCN (BRAIN Initiative Cell Census Network) motor cortex single-cell transcriptomic atlas
integration.join_key: Allen Common Coordinate Framework (CCF) brain-region IDs and coordinates
integration.bigger_question_one_sentence: Can cell-type composition at a cortical location predict its subcortical projection pattern, without circular module labels?

controls.positive_control: Recover the known primary vs secondary motor cortex (MOp vs MOs) split from projections.
controls.external_validation: Single-neuron projectome reconstructions (e.g. MouseLight), not checked.

honest_claim_h3: Predicting module membership from projection profiles would only reproduce the authors' clustering of those same profiles, among 547 Allen injection sites.

plain_idea.one_liner: Use the brain areas a motor-cortex site sends fibres to, to predict which of 16 motor-cortex modules that site belongs to.
plain_idea.train_on: Per injection experiment, the amount of labelled axon in each downstream brain region; about 547 experiments (press figure, unverified).
plain_idea.predict: Module identity (1 of 16); but the 'true answer' is the authors' clustering of the same projection data, not an independent measurement.
plain_idea.why_worthwhile: Little: it would reproduce a clustering. A non-circular version (predict projections from gene expression) needs data this paper did not deposit.

label_elsewhere.sources: Module labels exist only in this paper.
label_elsewhere.why: Rejected; no external label set for these modules.

ml_idea: Classify the module of a cortical site from its projection profile; rejected because the modules are clusters of those very profiles.

effort.compute_note: Not estimated; rejected at Part A.
effort.cheapest_killing_check: Look for a deposited module-assignment table on the Cell STAR Methods / BrainGlobe; even if found, the label stays circular.

verdict_reason: Paywalled, with no deposited data found; the only label (16 projection modules) is a clustering of the input projections, so it is circular (A8), and there are only ~547 source experiments, all reanalysed from the public Allen atlas.
